phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, around 180 seconds, with both players expanding and investing in economy. Opponent's tech is heavy but army composition is unknown.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when the opponent's first combat units are observed or when you reach a new tech milestone.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and ground army development, maintain production, and adapt technology based on scouting.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing your economy and ground forces. Maintain production and consider increasing technology to keep pace with the opponent's heavy tech investment.
phase_policies.title: Early Economy and Ground Foundation
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a single unit composition or neglect scouting, leaving you unprepared for the opponent's heavy tech investment.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame around 240 seconds, with both players still expanding. You have Zerglings and Queens, while the opponent remains unknown.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when the opponent's first combat units are seen or when you reach a new tech milestone.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Reinforce ground forces, expand economy, and maintain production while scouting for tech adaptation.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen your ground army and continue economic growth. Maintain production and consider adding more tech to match the opponent's heavy investment.
phase_policies.title: Early-Midgame Ground Reinforcement
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a single unit composition or neglect scouting, leaving you unprepared for the opponent's heavy tech investment.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame around 480 seconds, with both players having ground armies. Opponent shows Stalkers, Dark Templars, Warp Prisms, and Observers.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if the opponent adds air units or if you need to adjust your composition.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground forces, add detection, and mix in counters to handle multiple threats.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your ground army and maintain economy. Consider adding detection and units that counter stalkers and dark templars, such as overseers and banelings.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground vs Ground
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect detection or overcommit to a single unit type, leaving your army vulnerable to Dark Templar harassment and lacking counters to Stalkers.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame around 600 seconds, with the opponent having a ground army including Void Rays. You have a strong ground army with air support.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if the opponent adds more anti-air or if you need to adjust your composition.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Balance air and ground strength, add Corruptors for Void Ray counter, and sustain economy.
phase_policies.target: Continue to strengthen your air and ground forces. Consider adding Corruptors to counter Void Rays and maintain your economy.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Air Transition
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect anti-air or overcommit to ground-only forces, leaving you vulnerable to Void Rays.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
